items.title: Community & Creator Cause: @tiffanyleeproject (TikTok)
items.content_html: Creator community cause page for @tiffanyleeproject on TikTok. Open-ended direct support (no A/B voting). Status: Locked/pending manual creator verification (TikTok + wallet). Honest-zero until verified on-chain receipts.
